c11_bs_cbse_06_001: Social responsibility isn't charity — fair wages and clean processes are obligations, not gifts. Check: duty or donation?
c11_bs_cbse_06_002: The arguments aren't preaching — each shows how business resources solve social problems better. Check: what's the causal link?
c11_bs_cbse_06_003: The 'against' list is critics' theory, not real behaviour — the 'reality' forces explain actual compliance. Check: theory or practice?
c11_bs_cbse_06_004: Shareholders get a fair return on a safe investment — not maximum dividends at any cost. Check: short-term or sustainable?
c11_bs_cbse_06_005: Ethics isn't CSR or mere legality — it's the moral code behind operations. Check: is it an element or an activity?
c11_bs_cbse_06_006: Donations can't launder a rotten core — ethical responsibility runs through daily operations. Check: ethical or discretionary?
c11_bs_cbse_06_007: Obeying the law is the floor, not the fulfilment — responsibility asks for voluntary fairness beyond it. Check: legal floor or ethical ask?
c11_bs_cbse_06_008: CSR isn't optional kindness — thresholds make it mandatory and staff welfare doesn't count. Check: is the spend statutory?
c11_bs_cbse_06_009: Unfair trade practice has no size exemption — a street vendor's hollow measure counts too. Check: does scale matter?
c11_bs_cbse_06_010: Protection isn't just filters at the pipe's end — redesigning the process prevents pollution at source. Check: treat or prevent?
c11_bs_cbse_07_001: A paid CA drafting documents isn't a promoter — promotion is a legal status with fiduciary duties. Check: was it for a fee?
c11_bs_cbse_07_002: Promoters don't automatically own or direct — and pre-incorporation contracts can never be ratified. Check: did the company exist yet?
c11_bs_cbse_07_003: Incorporation is birth, not permission to trade — and the registrar checks form, not truth. Check: can the company start business yet?
c11_bs_cbse_07_004: The MoA isn't as flexible as the Articles — object changes need more, and ultra vires acts can't be saved. Check: which document governs?
c11_bs_cbse_07_005: 'Subsidiary' doesn't mean ignorable — the Articles bind like a contract and need a special resolution. Check: which resolution type?
c11_bs_cbse_07_006: Incorporation gives birth; commencement gives permission — conclusive evidence shields the fact, not illegal acts. Check: which certificate allows trading?
c11_bs_cbse_07_007: Hitting minimum subscription isn't enough — allotment also needs listing, and 90% is of the issue size. Check: which 90%?
c11_bs_cbse_07_008: The commencement certificate isn't public-only — both company types need it within 180 days. Check: public or private?
c11_bs_cbse_07_009: A company can't ratify what was signed before it existed — there was no principal then. Check: when was it signed?
c11_bs_cbse_07_010: Ultra vires the Articles can still be ratified — only acts beyond the Memorandum are dead. Check: which document was exceeded?
c11_bs_cbse_08_001: Finance isn't just bank loans — equity and retained profits count, and one source fits several lenses. Check: borrowed or owned?
c11_bs_cbse_08_002: Long-term doesn't mean owner's — debentures are long-term and borrowed. Check: which two axes apply?
c11_bs_cbse_08_003: Fixed dividend doesn't make preference shares debt — they're still owner's capital. Check: share or loan?
c11_bs_cbse_08_004: No compulsory dividend doesn't mean free — equity carries the highest expected return. Check: what's the cost of equity?
c11_bs_cbse_08_005: Preference dividend isn't a charge on profits — it's an appropriation, and they can't sue for it. Check: is profit even available?
c11_bs_cbse_08_006: Debentures aren't just bank loans — they can be unsecured, convertible and tradable. Check: is there always collateral?
c11_bs_cbse_08_007: Retained earnings aren't free — shareholders' expected return is the real cost. Check: does 12% beat their required 15%?
c11_bs_cbse_08_008: 'No interest' trade credit can hide ~37% a year if you skip the early-payment discount. Check: what discount did you forgo?
c11_bs_cbse_08_009: Banks lend short from deposits; development institutions fund long projects — not interchangeable. Check: asset life or liability term?
c11_bs_cbse_08_010: A lease never makes you the owner — hire purchase does when the last instalment clears. Check: bailment or agreement to sell?
c11_bs_cbse_08_011: The cheapest-looking source can hide costs — lost discounts, opportunity cost, supplier limits. Check: what's the hidden price?
c11_bs_cbse_09_001: Both investment and turnover must fit the class — it lands in the highest where both hold. Check: do both limits pass?
c11_bs_cbse_09_002: MSMEs aren't just mini-factories — they run where big industry can't, balancing regions. Check: jobs or also location?
c11_bs_cbse_09_003: The seven MSME problems chain together — tight finance ripples into weak marketing and back. Check: which problem causes the next?
c11_bs_cbse_09_004: Not every scheme hands out money — some guarantee loans, some refinance, some create demand. Check: what instrument is it?
c11_bs_cbse_09_005: Entrepreneurial risk is calculated — odds assessed and tilted by skill, not a lottery ticket. Check: can the odds be estimated?
c11_bs_cbse_09_006: A hired CEO isn't an entrepreneur — no personal risk, no uncertainty ownership. Check: who bears the failure?
c11_bs_cbse_09_007: An EDP isn't only for ready founders — it builds the person before the idea. Check: did they start with a plan?
c11_bs_cbse_09_008: The type labels stack — one entrepreneur can be technical, small, urban and innovative at once. Check: which axes all apply?
c11_bs_cbse_09_009: Development isn't just 'more GDP' — trace the mechanism: savings, innovation, regional spread. Check: risk or uncertainty?
